payload.content:
name: techvault-enterprise-web
description: 'Curated TechVault enterprise-web slice. Declares the enterprise tier,
  the Wazuh monitoring core those hosts report to, and the OTEL observability core,
  without the wider SOC or red-team apparatus.

  '
nodes:
  dmz-net:
    type: switch
    description: TechVault DMZ network.
  internal-net:
    type: switch
    description: Internal enterprise target network.
  security-net:
    type: switch
    description: SOC and security tooling network.
  webapp:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 8080
      protocol: tcp
      name: http
  db:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 5432
      protocol: tcp
      name: postgres
  ad:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 389
      protocol: tcp
      name: ldap
    - port: 88
      protocol: tcp
      name: kerberos
    - port: 445
      protocol: tcp
      name: smb
  workstation:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 22
      protocol: tcp
      name: ssh
  wazuh-manager:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    conditions:
      wazuh-manager-health: ''
    services:
    - port: 55000
      protocol: tcp
      name: wazuh-api
    - port: 1514
      protocol: tcp
      name: agent-events
    - port: 514
      protocol: udp
      name: syslog
  wazuh-indexer:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 9200
      protocol: tcp
      name: indexer-api
  aptl-otel-collector:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 4317
      protocol: tcp
      name: otlp-grpc
    - port: 4318
      protocol: tcp
      name: otlp-http
  aptl-tempo:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 3200
      protocol: tcp
      name: tempo-http
  aptl-grafana-otel:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 3000
      protocol: tcp
      name: grafana
infrastructure:
  dmz-net:
    properties:
      cidr: 172.20.1.0/24
      gateway: 172.20.1.1
      internal: true
  internal-net:
    properties:
      cidr: 172.20.2.0/24
      gateway: 172.20.2.1
      internal: true
  security-net:
    properties:
      cidr: 172.20.0.0/24
      gateway: 172.20.0.1
      internal: false
  webapp:
    links:
    - dmz-net
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - db
    - wazuh-manager
  db:
    links:
    - internal-net
  ad:
    links:
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
  workstation:
    links:
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-manager
  wazuh-manager:
    links:
    - security-net
    - internal-net
    dependencies:
    - wazuh-indexer
  wazuh-indexer:
    links:
    - security-net
  aptl-otel-collector:
    links:
    - security-net
  aptl-tempo:
    links:
    - security-net
  aptl-grafana-otel:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - aptl-tempo
features:
  techvault-webapp-service:
    type: service
    source:
      name: aptl-webapp
      version: local
    description: TechVault vulnerable customer portal service.
conditions:
  wazuh-manager-health:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-wazuh-manager
    interval: 30
    description: Declarative healthcheck required before public startup is ready.
